scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @novel/db build && pnpm --filter @novel/sources build && pnpm --filter @novel/translation build && pnpm --filter @novel/core build
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @novel/web build && pnpm --filter @novel/worker build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n db,sources,translation,core,web,worker "pnpm --filter @novel/db dev" "pnpm --filter @novel/sources dev" "pnpm --filter @novel/translation dev" "pnpm --filter @novel/core dev" "pnpm --filter @novel/web dev" "pnpm --filter @novel/worker dev"
